title: American Association of Endodontists Launches AAE Marketplace, Connecting Members with Products and Services for Their Practices
html:
New online resource features more than 140 solution providers, offering endodontists a centralized destination to discover products, explore services and share recommendations

CHICAGO — The American Association of Endodontists (AAE) has announced the launch of AAE Marketplace, a new online resource designed to connect endodontists with companies offering products, services and solutions tailored to the specialty. With more than 140 solution providers listed at launch, the platform gives AAE members a convenient way to research offerings, discover new resources and make informed decisions for their practices.

Available at marketplace.aae.org, AAE Marketplace brings together solution providers serving the endodontic community in a centralized, easy-to-navigate platform. Members can browse company profiles, explore products and services, access special offers and educational content, and share recommendations based on their own experiences.

“Endodontists rely on a wide range of products, technologies and professional services to deliver exceptional patient care and manage successful practices,” said AAE Executive Director Ken Widelka. “With AAE Marketplace, we’re making it easier for our members to explore the many solutions available to them and connect with companies that understand the needs of our specialty. We’re excited to offer a resource that members can turn to throughout the year as their practices and professional needs evolve.”

Developed specifically for the endodontic community, Marketplace offers a more focused experience than traditional dental industry directories. Its listings span a variety of products and services relevant to endodontic practice, allowing members to research options in an environment tailored to their professional interests.

The platform also expands opportunities for companies serving the specialty to connect with AAE members beyond annual meetings, trade shows and traditional advertising. Solution providers can maintain a complimentary listing, while enhanced annual subscriptions offer additional ways to highlight their organization’s products and services.

Among the first companies to take advantage of these enhanced opportunities are Endo Direct and Endo Mastery, which have secured a Diamond-level subscriptions, and ClikTech, LLC, which has joined at the Silver level. Their early participation reflects growing opportunities for year-round engagement with the endodontic community.

As members explore Marketplace, they can also contribute to its value by sharing recommendations based on their experiences, helping colleagues learn more about available solutions. These contributions reflect individual member perspectives and do not constitute endorsements by the AAE.

“One of the strengths of the AAE is the professional community we’ve built around advancing endodontics,” Widelka added. “Marketplace extends that sense of connection by giving members another way to exchange insights, discover resources and engage with the organizations that serve our specialty.”

AAE members are encouraged to visit marketplace.aae.org to explore the growing directory of solution providers and discover resources to support their practices.

About the American Association of Endodontists

The American Association of Endodontists represents the specialty of endodontics and is dedicated to advancing the art and science of endodontics and promoting the highest standards of patient care. The AAE serves as a leading resource for endodontic education, research, advocacy and public awareness, supporting its members in their commitment to saving natural teeth. For more information, visit aae.org.
